title: Þeistareykir 地熱工程
summary: 以火山熱源、分期機組與環境整合解析Þeistareykir 地熱工程：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Theistareykir geothermal engineering through volcanic heat, phased units and environmental integration: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Þeistareykir 地熱工程案例中比較Theistareykir熱源與井羣與採樣，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate theistareykir heat source and wellfields/sampling within the Theistareykir geothermal engineering case.

steps.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Reservoir concepts and observables: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Theistareykir熱源提出可反駁的儲層概念與可觀測量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir concepts and observables model and evidence record for theistareykir heat source.
steps.instruction: 在「Þeistareykir 地熱工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Theistareykir熱源。地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 建立儲層概念與可觀測量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是火山熱源、分期機組與環境整合。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify theistareykir heat source in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Theistareykir geothermal engineering. Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir concepts and observables, focusing on volcanic heat, phased units and environmental integration. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
steps.check: 提交Theistareykir熱源的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for theistareykir heat source.

knowledge.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量
knowledge.text: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 本課架構對應：Theistareykir熱源
knowledge.textEn: Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Course architecture correspondence: Theistareykir heat source

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設流體15 kg/s、比焓降250 kJ/kg，熱量率=3750 kW；轉換效率0.12、輔機100 kW，淨電=350.0 kW。未含儲層可持續性、相變細節與回注冷卻，非鑽井或現場設定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume flow 15 kg/s and enthalpy drop 250 kJ/kg: heat rate 3750 kW. At conversion 0.12 and auxiliaries 100 kW, net=350.0 kW. Reservoir sustainability, phase details and reinjection cooling are omitted; no field settings are given.

quiz.question: 就Theistareykir熱源的「儲層概念與可觀測量」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for reservoir concepts and observables in theistareykir heat source?
options: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。
測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation.
A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
quiz.explanationEn: Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.

steps.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Reservoir concepts and observables: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Theistareykir熱源提出可反駁的儲層概念與可觀測量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir concepts and observables model and evidence record for theistareykir heat source.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「儲層概念與可觀測量」模型，檢查Theistareykir熱源的兩個假想案例。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous reservoir concepts and observables model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving theistareykir heat source. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
steps.check: 提交Theistareykir熱源的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for theistareykir heat source.

steps.title: 井筒完整性與熱損：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Well integrity and heat loss: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對井羣與採樣提出可反駁的井筒完整性與熱損模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable well integrity and heat loss model and evidence record for wellfields/sampling.
steps.instruction: 在「Þeistareykir 地熱工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識井羣與採樣。井筒把地下流體連至地面；材料、熱變形與密封有不同失效證據。 建立井筒完整性與熱損的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是火山熱源、分期機組與環境整合。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify wellfields/sampling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Theistareykir geothermal engineering. Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well integrity and heat loss, focusing on volcanic heat, phased units and environmental integration. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：井口穩定就證明所有地下密封完整。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A stable wellhead proves every subsurface seal intact.
steps.check: 提交井羣與採樣的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for wellfields/sampling.
